lesson: Hormozi 2027 strategy video, numbered process (Use for us #2)

slides.sub: 6 years in real estate taught me to watch them. Miss attorney review and you can lose your chance to change the deal.

slides.title: 1. Your offer
slides.body: Finding a home takes 2 to 4 weeks on average in NJ. Once you pick one, making the offer takes [[24 hours or less]]. Know your budget before you tour.

slides.title: 2. Attorney review
slides.body: It can take 24+ hours, but [[3 days is the deadline]]. Weekends and legal holidays don't count. Then it's binding unless an attorney disapproves. Talk to a real estate attorney about your situation.

slides.title: 3. Loan Estimate
slides.body: After you apply, your lender has [[3 business days]] to send it. Use it to compare lenders side by side. Talk to a licensed lender for your numbers.

slides.title: 4. Closing Disclosure
slides.body: You must get it at least [[3 business days before closing]]. Check it against your Loan Estimate. If it hasn't come, ask your lender right away.
